name: 丝滑垂坠床单四件套款
description: 床笠深包角、平整铺陈与真实卧房安睡场景，体感卖点以空位承载

styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternate a sunlit bedroom with a light oak headboard, dappled wall shadows and small bedside props against clean infographic fields on white #FFFFFF, warm ivory #F6F3EF and greige #C7BAB2; one blush wall #F1E4DE carries every lifestyle frame so the set reads as one campaign
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused daylight as the master system, front key with a low fill card, a gentle skimming side light that reveals weave, drape and hem topstitching, sweeping highlights along folded edges, low-contrast contact shadows, fabric always resting on a surface and never floating
styleLock.surfaceSystem: dressed mattress on a light wood bed base over a warm walnut floor; folded stacks and detail crops on a smooth ivory board; fabric laid, folded or held taut by hands, never suspended without support
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family; any in-image copy wrapped in 「」 and supplied only as generic placeholders, headline 28-40pt, label 12-16pt, no serif or handwriting mixing, no dense body text
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line pictograms inside solid slate-blue circular chips plus rounded pill label chips in the same accent #3E5C82, single stroke weight, empty ruled label lines instead of values
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 eye-level hero angle for the dressed bed, identical roll and fold scale across variant rows, consistent drape direction, product always grounded with a contact shadow, people cropped or turned away so no face is identifiable
noDrift: no invented dimensions, piece counts, certifications or test data
no brand wordmark, woven label, barcode or QR code
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean home-textile bedding commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a pure white fabric field #FFFFFF, a warm blush wall #F1E4DE, a slate-blue accent #3E5C82 and deep charcoal text #2D2D2D; neutral temperature; one modern geometric sans-serif family with every in-image label wrapped in 「」 and supplied only as generic placeholders, headline 28-40pt and label 12-16pt, no serif or handwriting mixing and no dense body text; backgrounds alternate between a sunlit bedroom with a light oak headboard, dappled wall shadows and small bedside props and clean infographic fields on white #FFFFFF, warm ivory #F6F3EF or greige #C7BAB2; soft diffused daylight as the master lighting system with a front key, a low fill card and a gentle skimming side light that reveals weave, drape and hem topstitching, sweeping highlights along folded edges and low-contrast contact shadows, fabric always resting on a surface and never floating; consistent thin-line pictograms inside solid slate-blue circular chips plus rounded pill label chips with empty ruled label lines instead of values; stable slight 3/4 eye-level hero angle for the dressed bed and identical scale and spacing across every row; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no invented dimensions, piece counts, certifications or test data, no brand wordmark, woven label, barcode or QR code.

shots.intent: 用挺括平整的铺床效果和晨光氛围在搜索列表里一眼抢点击。

shots.lighting: soft diffused window key from camera-left at 5200K, gentle skimming highlight travelling along the folds, low-contrast shadow where fabric meets mattress
shots.background: warm blush painted wall #F1E4DE with dappled leaf shadows and a light oak headboard #D8B98E
shots.props: one small round oak bedside table #C79A63 with a clear glass vase of fresh stems, kept clear of the fabric
shots.whitespace: generous clean negative space across the upper-left wall reserved for copy
shots.promptTemplate: Bedroom styling hero of {product} dressed on a made bed with two pillows propped upright at the headboard. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Camera at a slight 3/4 eye-level angle from the near corner of the bed so the folded drape of the top layer and the twin pleated bands on the pillow shams read clearly, headboard and mattress base fully inside the frame with nothing clipped. Soft diffused window key from camera-left at 5200K, a gentle skimming highlight travelling along the folds, low-contrast shadow where the fabric meets the mattress. Background a warm blush painted wall #F1E4DE with dappled leaf shadows, a light oak headboard #D8B98E and one small round oak bedside table #C79A63 holding a clear glass vase of fresh stems kept clear of the fabric. The dressed bed occupies 60-70% of the frame. Generous clean negative space across the upper-left wall reserved for copy. Vertical 4:5 crop, 4K, commercial home-textile e-commerce quality. Negative: no color swatch strip along the bottom edge, no brand wordmark or woven label, no marketplace badge or award laurel, no star rating row, no extra text, no watermark, no QR code, no clipped bed corners, no glossy plastic sheen on the fabric, no crumpled used laundry look, no floating pillows without contact shadows.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：01 晨光卧房铺床主图带枕套折裥细节，底部压一条多色卷样色带；02 灰褐影棚内怀抱折叠布件，左侧标题加三条引线圆点标签；03 手压床笠包角，左侧三枚圆角标签片加右侧竖向双箭头尺寸线；04 卧房人物坐于白床品中，下方三枚圆底线性图标加两行标签；05 双人侧卧安睡，左侧四枚圆角标签片；06 双手拉开枕套折裥袖口，顶部两行标题；07 白场中布料斜向飘动，左侧两枚圆底图标加底部宽标签条；08 四人同床欢笑的温馨收口，顶部标题加一行五角星与底部另一品类的搭配购买说明。品类判定依据：全部图为床单/床笠/枕套类铺床织物与其卧房与棚拍信息图，非服装非家清工具，故 L1 家具家纺、L2 床品（源列表字段仅作文案线索，未参与判定）。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与原平台店铺字样、面料认证角标与平台环保承诺角标、五角星评价条与社会证明数字、图内全部原句文案（含适配厚度与件数等数值主张，一律改 {callout_n} 空位）、成人与儿童模特身份与面容（改为背影或颈部以下裁切）、底部色带的具体色号（改为 {accent_color} 与按 SKU 现场定色）。体感类断言（凉感、透气、排汗、防皱防起球等）不在任何字段中写实，仅作 leaf 与检索词语义，图内文案位置全部以 {selling_point_n} 空位承载；源图仅一张带色卡条，其余分镜构图互不重复，故按正常转化处理。
